reviews.text: Our grandson goes to preschool here. Its a very nice church and the people seem very nice.

reviews.text: Very nice services and the members are very kind and helpful.

reviews.text: A small congregation of the Brethren denominations group. Friendly, accepting, good youth program. I had Googled about them after attending a service. I found that a lot of things have been updated to cultural norms.
reviews.author: Gaylord H.
